text:
sara-peopleops: FYI: Marcus (eng) submitted a resignation today. Last day 2026-04-10. Hes on an H1B (sponsored), has equity vesting schedule, company phone, and an on-site badge. Need to coordinate visa stop, final pay + equity vesting/proration, COBRA, phone return, badge deactivation, and a knowledge-transfer session. Looping liam, priyanka, payroll-bot, facilities, security-bot.

liam-mgr: Thanks. Confirming hell do a 2-week notice. Requesting a 90-min doc + handoff session with the team next Tue 04-07. Also: he owns the internal SDK repo and two service runbooks. Will start ownership transfers today.

priyanka-it: Noted. For sponsored employees we follow visa termination protocol: we'll notify immigration team after final day is confirmed; system access workflow: keep Okta/Slack/GitHub until EOD 2026-04-10 to allow handoff, then revoke. For AWS keys we prefer to rotate keys and remove IAM roles on 04-11 09:00 PT. Need serial for phone and asset tag for laptop/phone.

payroll-bot: Payroll checklist: final salary prorate, unpaid PTO payout (if any), equity cliff/vesting check, COBRA packet creation. I need Marcus home mailing + personal email for benefits (or confirm secure delivery) and timesheets by 2026-04-03 to run in 04-07 payroll batch. Please confirm.

sara-peopleops: Marcus prefers company to use secure HR email method, but if not possible use marcus.personal+rw@gmail.com marked confidential. Liam will collect timesheets and confirm receipts.

liam-mgr: I'll get timesheets + receipts by 04-03. Also to-do: transfer Notion pages and internal SDK ownership to "platform-team" before 04-10 18:00. Marcus agreed to hold a 30-min async Q&A thread after the handoff.

facilities: For badge + phone returns: we can accept drop-off at SF office by 04-11. If Marcus is remote, we can send a prepaid label. Which is it?

sara-peopleops: Marcus is relocating to Austin but will be remote after 04-05. Please send prepaid label for phone and badge box. Provide tracking to HR when shipped.

priyanka-it: Deprovision schedule proposal:

```
2026-04-10 18:00 PT - Disable Okta new sessions (allow existing sessions until midnight)
2026-04-11 09:00 PT - Revoke AWS roles + rotate service keys
2026-04-11 12:00 PT - Remove GitHub org membership and transfer repo ownership
2026-04-11 18:00 PT - Disable Slack account
```

liam-mgr: Can we delay GitHub removal until 04-11 18:00 to let him do final branch cleanup? Otherwise fine.

priyanka-it: OK change noted: GitHub removal 04-11 18:00. We'll wait for repo transfer before revoking Notion. Add a step: snapshot his IAM keys and S3 buckets list for audit.

payroll-bot: Equity: Marcus has a mid-cycle partial vest due 04-01. Need to confirm whether his termination triggers pro-rata vesting under his grant. Ill escalate to comp. Meanwhile I'll prepare gross/net estimates for final pay to share with Marcus by 04-04.

sara-peopleops: I'll open comp case. Also scheduling optional exit interview 04-14 10:00 PT (30 min) — prefer remote. Will send calendar invite.

security-bot: Reminder: if Marcus had any production SSH keys on his laptop, please ensure keys are rotated and any personal keys revoked. If he had SSO sessions with external vendors, ask him to confirm revocations.

liam-mgr: He does have deploy access to staging only. I'll remove service tokens and rotate any secrets in the next 48h and tag the PRs.

facilities: Prepaid return label scheduled for pickup 2026-04-12, ETA office 2026-04-14. We'll confirm tracking here.

priyanka-it: Once facilities confirms receipt, IT will wipe company phone within 24h and deprovision laptop after asset intake. Please post tracking + asset tag to trigger wipe.

payroll-bot: COBRA: benefits will be eligible; packet to be generated by 2026-04-15. Need confirmation of delivery method.

sara-peopleops: Use secure HR portal link first; fallback to personal email if Marcus opts out. Liam to confirm his preference in the 1:1.

liam-mgr: Confirmed he prefers the HR portal. I'll update once he accepts.

sara-peopleops: Final checklist for thread: timesheets by 04-03, equity/comp case opened, prepaid label for phone/badge, deprovision schedule, repo + Notion transfer, exit interview invite. Please post updates as they happen. :white_check_mark:
